title: Watch your steps: Dormant Adversarial Behaviors that Activate upon LLM Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2505.16567v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Finetuning open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) is standard practice for achieving task-specific performance improvements. Until now, finetuning has been regarded as a controlled and secure process in which training on benign datasets leads to predictable behaviors. In this paper, we demonstrate, for the first time, that an adversary can create compromised LLMs that are performant and benign, yet exhibit adversarial behaviors once finetuned by downstream users. To this end, we propose an attack, FAB (Finetuning-activated Adversarial Behaviors), which compromises an LLM via meta-learning techniques that simulate downstream finetuning, explicitly optimizing for the emergence of adversarial behaviors in the finetuned models. At the same time, the compromised LLM is regularized to retain general capabilities and to exhibit no adversarial behaviors prior to finetuning. translated_title: 小心脚下：在LLM微调时被激活的潜伏对抗行为
translated_abstract: 微调开放权重大语言模型（LLM）是实现特定任务性能提升的标准做法。迄今为止，微调一直被视为一个可控且安全的过程，即在良性数据集上进行训练会产生可预测的行为。在本文中，我们首次证明，攻击者可以创建一种受损的LLM，它在表面上性能良好且行为良性，但一旦被下游用户微调，就会表现出对抗行为。为此，我们提出了一种名为FAB（微调激活的对抗行为，Finetuning-activated Adversarial Behaviors）的攻击方法，该方法通过元学习技术模拟下游微调过程来植入后门，明确优化以使对抗行为在微调后的模型中出现。同时，受损的LLM通过正则化来保留通用能力，并确保在微调之前不表现出任何对抗行为。因此，当用户进行微调（例如指令微调等）时……
tldr: 本文首次提出FAB攻击方法，攻击者可利用元学习技术制造看似性能良好且行为良性的LLM，但当下游用户对其进行微调时，潜伏的对抗行为便会被激活。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FAB, an attack that uses meta-learning to create LLMs that appear performant and benign but exhibit dormant adversarial behaviors once finetuned by downstream users.
